Gonzales, Sessions, Barr, and now Bondi — all paid a price for turning the Department of Justice into a partisan weapon. 

There’s a lesson in that, too.

MAGA Attorney General Pam Bondi cashed in her integrity to keep her job and now leaves with neither.  

It’s a lesson for people who fall for Trump.

Just like clockwork.


Sheldon Whitehouse (@SenWhitehouse)

Feb 13 — White House on Noem, in a statement:  “The President continues to have full confidence in the Secretary.”

Mar 6 — White House on Bondi, in a statement: “The President has full faith in the Attorney General.”

Start the clock.



— https://nitter.net/SenWhitehouse/status/2030050055114154085#m
He’s not a guy Republicans want being questioned by real lawyers under oath about his MAGA mischief at FBI and DOJ. Best to hit the flush button perhaps.

Good riddance to bad rubbish?

Those looming FBI agent lawsuits are going to be really ugly for Patel, and will be a huge problem for FBI and DOJ.

Here’s a question: if Bondi gets the Noem treatment, will a new AG want to put up with Patel’s shenanigans and baggage, or does he get the Lewandowski treatment and follow the boss out the door — a chance for Blanche to clean house for the new arrival?

Tragedy becomes farce.


Jamie Dupree (@jamiedupree)

The House has adjourned until next week without taking action on the DHS funding bill from the Senate.  That means the shutdown will continue until at least Monday.

Bondi fell into the Trump Trap, giving up her integrity to keep her job, and looks like she now will leave with neither.


Tyler Pager (@tylerpager)

NEWS: President Trump has discussed firing Attorney General Pam Bondi in recent days as he grows frustrated with her leadership at the Justice Department. He has floated the idea of replacing her with Lee Zeldin.

About time they figured it out. So much unnecessary pain and hassle when this was our offer all along.
